summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda appended at the end (Transform subclass, asserts callable(func) with "func must be callable", no base init call). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets the typing import changed to "Callable, Optional" (Optional is still used by DataStatsd), Lambda added to the array import list, the Lambdad class inserted between ConcatItemsd and the alias block (super().__init__(keys) first, then one internal Lambda; __call__ uses dict(data)), and LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended to the alias block. docs/source/transforms.rst gets Lambda under Vanilla Transforms before SplitChannel and Lambdad after ConcatItemsd before Transform Adaptors. New tests: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py (identity, slicing of spatial axes, unlisted-entry preservation, keys view with the image as sole entry, original mapping untouched). Verification was by reading the git diff and a line-length scan only: no tests, flake8, or black were run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
